title: GEMSDOE65 — Selection-Bias-Aware Fault Discovery
description: DOE GEMS Prize lane that models catalogue inclusion as selected at random conditional on observables and tests whether a SAR propensity-aware PU risk beats a matched nnPU baseline on identical spatially blocked folds. At the recorded head the repository documents a split it names itself: the primary lane carries a DO-NOT-SUBMIT verdict and the Pages root home page states the lane is not cleared for submission, while a second lane the README describes as cleared reports its own gate met. Its README also states plainly that no organizer score, leaderboard position or projection is claimed and that the absolute holdout proxy is not comparable to the public board range.
